description: Land Title Settlement Department - Henawatta, Mihintale D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad Map No. 110511 (24/0332)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations regarding specific parcels of land. It contains detailed information about land parcels (numbers, extents, ownership status, encumbrances) and represents an official declaration under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes, which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related administrative matters concerning land and property.
